project.name: JS Practice Loop
project.mission: Help one beginner learn JavaScript by attempting exercises independently, recording what went wrong, and returning to the same mistake later without turning the product into another course platform or AI answer generator.
project.targetUser: The owner: a Vietnamese beginner learning JavaScript who often becomes stuck, asks AI for the full solution, and then retains too little of the reasoning.
firstCriticalFlow: open an empty personal practice log
create one exercise record with prompt and source
write the learner's own attempt and short explanation
mark the attempt as solved or stuck
reload the page and recover the same attempt
successSignals: the learner records at least five real exercises without asking the app to generate answers
saved attempts survive reload without manual repair
the learner can identify a repeated mistake from their own records
nonGoals: an AI tutor or answer generator
a browser code runner or sandbox
social features, leaderboards, accounts, subscriptions, or teams
cross-device sync in the first version
automatic spaced-repetition algorithms before real usage shows a need

principles: the learner's attempt appears before any reflection or hint
plain Vietnamese labels and no gamification pressure
empty, saved, validation-error, and reload states are explicit
no navigation system until more than three top-level destinations exist
design.componentLibrary: none for the first slice; use semantic HTML and small repository-owned components

foundation.frontend: React with TypeScript using the official Vite React TypeScript template
foundation.styling: plain CSS with design tokens; no Tailwind or component library in the first slice
foundation.data: versioned JSON in browser localStorage behind a small repository interface
foundation.validation: small typed validation functions at the form and storage boundaries
testing: Vitest unit tests for domain and storage behavior
Playwright for the create-save-reload user flow
foundation.deployment: static hosting only after the local flow passes

boundaries: src/domain for attempt and status rules
rules: UI components do not read or write localStorage directly
exercise prompts and attempts are treated as plain text, never rendered as HTML
the app never executes learner code
storage schema changes require an explicit migration or reset decision
no framework, database, auth, or AI provider may be added without a recorded repeated need

sources: owner learning history and stated difficulty retaining solutions produced by AI
Anki Manual: active recall and spaced repetition
Vite official guide: React TypeScript template
unknowns: whether recording attempts changes the owner's learning behavior
whether localStorage remains sufficient after real use
whether review scheduling should be manual or follow a simple fixed interval
whether the learner wants code snippets stored as plain text
killCriteria: stop if the first useful flow cannot remain local-only and bounded
stop if the owner does not record five real exercises
drop any feature that mainly duplicates an existing course or flashcard tool
do not add AI answer generation because it recreates the original learning problem
